questions.prompt: Two web apps and a staging slot run in the same dedicated App Service plan. What compute relationship should the administrator expect?

options.text: They share the plan worker capacity.
options.explanation: Apps and slots consume resources from the same dedicated plan.

options.text: Each receives an independently billed dedicated worker set automatically.
options.explanation: Dedicated compute is allocated at plan level.

options.text: The staging slot runs in a different region automatically.
options.explanation: A slot uses the same hosting plan, not automatic regional isolation.

options.text: Stopping one app deletes the shared plan workers.
options.explanation: App lifecycle operations do not delete the plan.

questions.prompt: A resource-intensive app must have an independent compute and scaling boundary from other apps. Which design fits?

options.text: Place it in a separate App Service plan.
options.explanation: A separate plan separates the worker capacity and plan scaling.

options.text: Create only another deployment slot in the existing plan.
options.explanation: Slots still share the existing plan workers.

options.text: Change only the app resource group while retaining the plan.
options.explanation: Resource-group organization does not separate shared compute.

options.text: Assign a different custom hostname while retaining the plan.
options.explanation: DNS naming does not change the compute boundary.

questions.prompt: The only app in a paid dedicated App Service plan is stopped. What should be checked to stop unnecessary plan compute charges?

options.text: Whether the unused plan can be deleted or moved to a suitable lower tier.
options.explanation: The plan retains its allocated paid capacity while the app is stopped.

options.text: Assume the stopped app makes the dedicated plan free.
options.explanation: Billing is based on allocated plan resources.

options.text: Remove only the app custom domain.
options.explanation: Hostname configuration does not release the plan compute.

options.text: Delete only the app deployment history.
options.explanation: Deployment records do not determine worker allocation.
